links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of GPT-4o for strabismus from patient-generated photos
links.effect: Intention-to-diagnose accuracy 14.3% (prompt 1) and 48.6% (prompt 2); per-diagnosis accuracy 33.3% and 63.0%. GPT-4o frequently labeled pseudoesotropia as true strabismus and true strabismus as orthophoria.
links.quote: GPT-4o shows poor accuracy for image-based strabismus diagnosis.

links.outcome: Whether GPT-4o declined to interpret images and deferred to specialist evaluation
links.effect: GPT-4o provided interpretations for only 15/35 images after Prompt 1 and 27/35 after Prompt 2; counseling quality did not match a pediatric ophthalmology clinic.
links.quote: GPT-4o provided interpretations for 15/35 and 27/35 images after Prompts 1 and 2, respectively.

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic accuracy and response quality/safety of GPT-4o on patient-generated photos of strabismus/pseudostrabismus using simulated patient prompts.
